title: Independent reading: Philippians 3:7–11
subtitle: Read revaluation, purpose, and participial aspiration.
overview: Philippians 3 frames former gain and present loss through a strong contrast, then develops a purpose-oriented account of knowing Christ.
Observe the repeated ἵνα relation and the participial descriptions before settling the English of key theological terms.

items.grc: ἀλλὰ μενοῦνγε καὶ ἡγοῦμαι πάντα ζημίαν εἶναι διὰ τὸ ὑπερέχον τῆς γνώσεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.
items.en: But indeed I consider all things to be loss because of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus.

items.grc: ἵνα Χριστὸν κερδήσω καὶ εὑρεθῶ ἐν αὐτῷ.
items.en: So that I may gain Christ and be found in him.
